skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand basic concepts of accounting information systems, roles of accountants, development cycle, characteristics in digital economy.
Apply procedures for organizing accounting documentation, accounts, ledgers, and reports.
Understand database principles and organization in businesses.
Explain the significance of describing accounting information systems using various tools and differentiate between these tools.
Sketch accounting information systems using various tools to describe data flow, information, and document circulation for analysis and evaluation.
Develop basic computer skills using Microsoft Office products for organizing and designing accounting information systems.
Develop critical thinking skills to refine processes when applying accounting methods and policies in organizations.
Develop systems thinking skills to identify, classify, measure, record accounting transactions, and prepare financial statements in organizations.
Organize planning, coordination, management of resources, assessment, and improvement of activities.
